auditor_value: F_min = μmg/√(1+μ²) = mg sin30° = 12.5 kgf (≈ 122.5 N), pulled at 30° above the horizontal
notes: All three mistake entries produce the numbers they name (25 kgf; 6.25 kgf; 14.4 kgf for a horizontal pull). Working in kgf directly is valid since 1 kgf is the weight of 1 kg; the 9.8 N conversion is not needed for the options.
